(2) A young man in a light green polo shirt enters through the door, looking surprised. He holds a black traffic light prop that displays a pink heart-shaped light. (3) The man examines the woman's arm while holding a second traffic light prop showing a red light. Both characters use expressive facial gestures and hand movements while talking. (4) Transition to a montage of three Nivea product tubes—purple, green, and orange. Close-up shots show the green tube being squeezed and a white creamy serum applied to a forearm and elbow. (5) Both characters stand together in front of a neutral white wall, holding the Nivea Body Serum products. They point at the bottles and smile at the camera. (6) The video concludes with both characters holding up all three product variants, appearing energetic and cheerful. Text overlays dominate the bottom and center of the frame during the promotion.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a soft, airy female vocal whispering. This is immediately interrupted by a loud, high-pitched male voice and a creaking door sound. An energetic pop BGM with a strong percussive beat (approx. 124 BPM) kicks in. (2) A digital 'ding' and 'pop' SFX are heard as props are shown. The male voice continues in a humorous, high-arousal comedic tone while discussing the girl's love life. (3) A series of digital UI chirps and bubble sounds correspond to text overlays. The background music remains consistent with bright synthesizer textures and steady drum hits. (4) Transition whoosh SFX leads into a more professional, faster-paced narrative style. The male voice articulates product benefits (Vitamin C, AHA) clearly over the BGM. (5) Sound of light friction (simulating lotion application) is audible during the close-up montage. The music maintains high energy with a major modal feel. (6) A final crescendo of both male and female voices shouting a promotional slogan occurs. The audio concludes with a sharp musical stinger and hard cut silence.
